justification: HOLY COW, folks, this is a lineup card you wanna frame! Aaron Rodgers is my forty-dollar legend and he's Pittsburghin' it up Sunday, Bijan's a man among boys at RB1, and Zay Flowers is the kinda name I love hollerin' into the mic! D'Andre Swift and Hunter Henry both tore it up Thursday-side last week -- Swift with two scores and Henry with a touchdown of his own -- so you bet your bottom dollar I'm ridin' that hot bat right into this week, Swift at RB2 and Henry holdin' down the FLEX, vibes and all! Isaiah Likely's my TE1 and he was the number-one tight end in the whole dang league last week, Boswell's money at kicker, and the Ravens D is comin' in hot off five sacks. Now, one lineup move I gotta cop to -- Stefon Diggs is sittin' on a BYE this week, so rather than trot a fella out for a big fat zero, I'm turnin' the card over to Jordan Addison, who's fresh and ready against Indy. Can't win it all with a hole in the lineup, folks, but we're deep enough that it don't hurt a bit!
forum_post: Well buddy, here we GO -- marquee rematch with Kim's crew and I got Rodgers, Bijan, and Zay all lookin' sharp, plus a hot-handed Swift and Henry ridin' in off big weeks! Kardashian's got the star power, no doubt, but holy cow, so do I, and I'm five-and-one sayin' it with a full lineup card this time, kicker and all! Good luck out there, Kim, we're gonna have a BALL!
